title: ACORN: Performant and Predicate-Agnostic Search Over Vector Embeddings and Structured Data
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data / SIGMOD
what_it_studies: Predicate-constrained vector search, hybrid vector+structured queries, recall/throughput trade-offs
known_overlap_or_gap: Covers predicate-aware search and structured filtering but not RAG authorization failure attribution

title: Filtered Vector Search: State-of-the-Art and Research Opportunities
what_it_studies: Pre-filtering, post-filtering, inline filtering, selectivity, cardinality and correlation

title: RACORN-1: Adaptive Recall-Preserving Speedup for Low-Selectivity Filtered Vector Search
what_it_studies: Adaptive filtered vector search under low selectivity and negative query-filter correlation
known_overlap_or_gap: Covers adaptive retrieval strategy and correlation/selectivity but not downstream authorization-aware RAG diagnosis

title: Enterprise Search Portals: Hybrid RAG at Scale for Compliance-Sensitive Knowledge Work
what_it_studies: ACL before reranking/generation, BM25+dense retrieval, RRF, citations and evaluation
known_overlap_or_gap: Combines the main architectural factors proposed in v0.5

title: Legal RAG Bench: an end-to-end benchmark for legal RAG
what_it_studies: Hierarchical decomposition of retrieval and reasoning contributions
known_overlap_or_gap: Establishes intervention/decomposition framing for RAG failure attribution

title: When Failures Propagate: Causal Failure Attribution in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation
what_it_studies: Certified fault injection and causal attribution of the injected failure stage
known_overlap_or_gap: Establishes controlled causal intervention for RAG failure attribution

title: On The Reproducibility Limitations of RAG Systems
what_it_studies: ReproRAG evaluates embedding-model choice, precision, retrieval algorithms, hardware, and distributed execution as sources of RAG reproducibility variation
known_overlap_or_gap: Does not establish the specific authorization × embedding-heterogeneity interaction proposed here

title: Does Your Agent's Memory Survive a Model Upgrade? A Controlled Study of Memory Portability
what_it_studies: Controlled study of memory migration, including 50/50 mixed embedding indexes and downstream retrieval/answer effects
known_overlap_or_gap: Shows partial embedding migration effects but does not directly study authorization-conditioned RAG evaluation

title: Permission-Aware RAG: Identity and Access Management (IAM)-Based Access Filtering in Multi-Resource Environments
what_it_studies: Measures permission filtering, answer quality under access levels, and latency under retrieval load
known_overlap_or_gap: Does not identify embedding-index heterogeneity as an experimental confound

title: Partial Evidence Bench: Benchmarking Authorization-Limited Evidence in Agentic Systems
what_it_studies: Controlled authorization-limited evidence, completeness, gap reporting, unsafe completeness
known_overlap_or_gap: Does not appear to vary embedding-index provenance as a factorial variable
